rootNode.title: Build a SaaS — API-first B2C Developer Tool MVP
rootNode.description: Ship a solo-built API-first B2C developer tool MVP within 4–6 weeks to reach 100+ active users or paid customers.

children.title: Validate & Scope the API Product
Identify a high-frequency B2C API need (e.g., AI image gen, personal automation, data enrichment)
Interview 10–15 potential consumers in target communities (Reddit, Discord, Twitter)
Define 3 core API endpoints that solve the validated pain point end-to-end
Set pricing tiers: free tier (rate-limited) + 1 paid tier under $10/mo
Write a one-page product spec with input/output schemas and rate limits
Spike the riskiest technical dependency and confirm it works within constraints
Build the Core API Backend
Scaffold project with FastAPI/Express + PostgreSQL + Redis stack
Implement API key generation, hashing, and storage
Build authentication middleware that validates API keys per request
Develop the 3 core endpoints with input validation and error handling
Add per-key rate limiting and usage tracking with Redis counters
Create async background job pipeline for heavy endpoint processing
Write integration tests covering auth, rate limiting, and all endpoints
Containerize with Docker and deploy to a $20–30/mo cloud VM
Ship Developer-Facing Surfaces
Build a clean API reference docs page with code snippets in 3 languages (curl, Python, JS)
Create a signup/login dashboard for consumers to get API keys and manage billing
Implement Stripe checkout for the paid tier and auto-upgrade on payment
Add webhook receiver to Stripe to suspend/reactivate API keys on subscription changes
Write a Quickstart guide that gets a user from signup to first API call in under 5 minutes
Set up a public status page (e.g., BetterStack) for uptime transparency
Acquire First 100+ Users
Launch on Product Hunt with a compelling demo video and founder story
Post the API with open-source wrapper examples on GitHub and pin to profile
Write 3 blog posts: tutorial, comparison vs DIY, and a creative consumer use case
Share in relevant subreddits and Hacker News (Show HN) during week 4–5
Create 2–3 short-form demo videos and post on Twitter, TikTok, and YouTube Shorts
Set up referral system: free users get bonus credits for each referred paid signup
Monitor churn and collect NPS feedback weekly; patch top-3 friction points within 48 hours
Operate & Iterate Post-Launch
Set up error alerting (Sentry) and latency monitoring dashboards for all endpoints
Add automated daily usage email digests to keep users engaged
Triage feature requests in a public Canny/feedback board and ship top-voted item bi-weekly
Benchmark API latency vs closest competitor and optimize to win on speed by week 6

rootNode.title: Build a B2B Enterprise Workflow Automation SaaS Product
rootNode.description: Build and launch a workflow automation and productivity SaaS for B2B enterprise teams, integrating with existing enterprise stacks (SSO, APIs), and generating paying customers within 3 months.

children.title: Market Validation & Product Definition
Conduct 15+ customer discovery interviews with target enterprise teams
Define MVP feature set and prioritization based on interview insights
Map top 3-5 enterprise integration requirements (SSO, APIs, directories)
Document core user personas, use cases, and success metrics
Core Platform Architecture & Infrastructure
Set up cloud infrastructure with multi-tenant data isolation
Implement authentication system with SAML/OIDC SSO support
Build role-based access control (RBAC) and team management
Design and implement REST and webhook API layer
Workflow Automation Engine
Build visual workflow builder with drag-and-drop interface
Implement trigger system (scheduled, webhook, event-driven)
Develop action library with pre-built integrations and custom scripting
Create workflow execution engine with logging and error handling
Productivity Tooling Features
Build task and project management dashboard
Implement team collaboration tools (comments, assignments, notifications)
Create reporting and analytics module with exportable insights
Enterprise Integrations
Integrate with major SSO providers (Okta, Azure AD, Google Workspace)
Build native connectors for top 5 enterprise tools (Slack, Jira, Salesforce, etc.)
Implement SCIM for automated user provisioning and deprovisioning
Set up API gateway with rate limiting and usage auditing
Billing, Pricing & Revenue Operations
Integrate subscription billing platform (Stripe Billing or similar)
Define tiered pricing model with self-serve and sales-led options
Build usage tracking and metering for pay-as-you-go components
Create customer onboarding checkout and contract flow for enterprises
Security, Compliance & Trust
Implement SOC 2 Type II controls and documentation framework
Set up encryption at rest and in transit with key management
Conduct penetration test and remediate findings
Create security whitepaper and compliance documentation for buyers
Go-to-Market & Early Revenue
Launch private beta with 5-10 design partner companies
Build sales collateral (decks, demo scripts, ROI calculator)
Run outbound sales campaign targeting 200 ideal customer profiles
Publish on enterprise marketplaces (Slack App Directory, Atlassian, etc.)
Close first 3-5 paid customers with annual contracts
